correctness.rationale: Assuming the published matroid Schubert Cartier divisor/class-group criterion, mK Cartier iff an integer cocircuit weight vector has sum −2m on each cocircuit. At r=1 a single cocircuit admits integer weights summing −2, giving index 1. Exhaustive small subset divisibility consistency check n≤9; universal proof is elementary subset exchange conditional on prior criterion.
